newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Hariri forms new government.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Hariri forms new government.

text.p: Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri formed a new government on Thursday, an official announcement said.
The new government will total 30 members including Hariri, Hisham Al-Shahar, director-general of the cabinet said on television.
This is the same number as Hariri's outgoing cabinet.
All the top ministries in the outgoing team are unchanged, Shahar said.
